project_info.theme: Proof-of-visa success for an MBA fashion and creation student in Paris
project_info.color_palette: Soft Gray, Cream, Red, Navy Blue, Green Security Ink

main_subject.detail: A proof-style social poster centered on a close-up France student visa image, partially anonymized, with a cartoon duck sticker covering the portrait area and a bold red caption announcing a successful MBA freshman in Stylisme et Création at IFA Paris.
main_subject.style: Document-proof testimonial post with privacy-masked identity, authentic visa texture, and simple celebratory text layout.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality testimonial-style proof poster for a France student visa success. Centerpiece is a close-up French student visa image with personal details blurred and the face area covered by a cartoon duck sticker. Background is the authentic visa paper texture itself. Surrounding elements: VFE logo, visible visa labels 'FRA', 'MULT', date '13-07-26', and bold red success caption '1995 TÂN SINH VIÊN MBA STYLISME ET CREATION - IFA PARIS'. Technical style: document-proof testimonial poster, documentary realism with privacy masking, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
